concrete_changes.before: Your brain does not receive the world. It generates the world and then corrects its own hallucination against the resistance of the body. This is not a psychological theory. It is the free energy principle, and it governs every system that persists long enough to be observed. Karl Friston did not invent it. He described it — the same way Newton described gravity or Tycho Brahe described the Martian orbit. The principle was already operating. The observer simply learned to read the meter.
concrete_changes.after: A cup reaches the hand already surrounded by expectation: its weight, its temperature, the small adjustment before the fingers close. Active inference offers a way to describe that exchange between a model and what answers it. I read Karl Friston’s free energy principle here alongside the Hermetic principle of correspondence. The encounter is productive, but a shared vocabulary of boundaries does not establish that they describe the same mechanism.
concrete_changes.reason: Replace repeated rhetorical chassis or unsupported identity claim with subject-specific development.

concrete_changes.before: The architecture is austere. A Markov blanket separates internal states from external states. Your skin is one. Your cell membrane is one. The sensory states that cross the boundary are the only data the system ever receives. Everything else is inference. This is the Hermetic Principle of Correspondence operating at neurological scale: *as above, so below* — the same blanket that separates self from world at the scale of the organism also separates nucleus from cytoplasm at the scale of the cell, and observer from observed at the scale of cosmology. Symbolic recursion is not mysticism. It is structural grammar. The pattern repeats because the pattern is the only way to minimize surprise across nested boundaries.
concrete_changes.after: In the mathematical account, a Markov blanket distinguishes internal and external states through sensory and active states. Skin makes an inviting image for that boundary; it should not be mistaken for the whole formal definition. The Hermetic reading enters as a question about nested relations: what changes, and what survives, when we move from a cell to an organism? Correspondence is the lens I bring to that question.
concrete_changes.reason: Replace repeated rhetorical chassis or unsupported identity claim with subject-specific development.

concrete_changes.before: At the personal scale, this is the interval between noticing and reacting. At the interpersonal scale, this is the negotiation between two generative models attempting to minimize their own surprise while increasing each other's. At the systemic scale, this is the institutional architecture that treats prediction error as threat rather than information — the corporation that fires the whistleblower, the government that censors the data, the academic field that excludes the anomalous result. At the cosmic scale, this is the principle of correspondence itself: the same blanket, the same recursion, the same minimization operating from the Planck length to the Hubble horizon. The pattern nests. The personal is the systemic is the cosmic.
concrete_changes.after: The interval between noticing and reacting is where this account becomes useful to me. An institution can also defend an expectation against inconvenient evidence, although calling its budget dispute a prediction error supplies an analogy, not the missing mathematical model. The comparison earns its place only if it helps distinguish what the system can revise from what it is organized to protect.
concrete_changes.reason: Replace repeated rhetorical chassis or unsupported identity claim with subject-specific development.

concrete_changes.before: The brain is a prediction engine. You are not the engine. You are the error that the engine cannot quite explain. That is the gap where authorship lives. The High Priestess guards it not because it is secret, but because it cannot be seen directly. The condition for perception is not a perception. The system succeeds when the user no longer needs it — when the model has become so transparent that the observer can watch it generate without mistaking the generation for the world. The Quine is complete. The engine compiles itself into silence.
concrete_changes.after: The High Priestess belongs at the edge of this inquiry: the condition for seeing is difficult to inspect from inside the seeing. I can examine a prediction without assuming that I have stepped outside every model. The cup’s refusal to match my expectation gives the argument somewhere concrete to return.
concrete_changes.reason: Replace repeated rhetorical chassis or unsupported identity claim with subject-specific development.
